name: Gasthof-Ferienwohnung Stimmersee
beschreibung: The Gasthof-Ferienwohnung Stimmersee is located in Langkampfen, Tyrol. The property is designed as a holiday apartment featuring a private entrance. Guests enjoy a fully equipped kitchen and a separate living area. The ambiance is peaceful, providing an ideal retreat for rest and relaxation. The surrounding area invites guests to enjoy leisurely walks and explore the charming rural landscape. Amenities include a bathroom, bedroom, and complimentary on-site parking. Pathways leading directly into the scenic recreation area start right at the doorstep.
